title: Digital clock: AM/PM is not localized and interrelated issues
line: The clock now writes AM/PM in the case the language uses, so Greek shows lower-case π.μ./μ.μ
explanation: The English-only AM/PM was already fixed in 6.6.1, but timeFormatCorrection() in DigitalClock.qml still appended the "AP" token, which Qt always turns into upper case. Greek (and other locales) write AM/PM in lower case, so the clock showed Π.Μ. instead of π.μ. The change uses Qt's "Ap" token, which keeps the locale's own case.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: use the locale's own case for AM/PM

The clock forced the AM/PM text to upper case, so locales that write it
in lower case, like Greek with π.μ. and μ.μ., showed it wrongly. Use the
"Ap" format, which keeps the case the locale gives the AM/PM text.

BUG: 497514

patches.diff:
From 109a1a2ebe7d72ba55c2fa44d2b5314396c14bf2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:55:28 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: use the locale's own case for AM/PM
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The clock forced the AM/PM text to upper case, so locales that write it
in lower case, like Greek with π.μ. and μ.μ., showed it wrongly. Use the
"Ap" format, which keeps the case the locale gives the AM/PM text.

BUG: 497514
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..24dac2bc85 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -526,7 +526,7 @@ MouseArea {
         const delimiter = match[2];
         const minutes = match[3]
         const seconds = "ss";
-        const amPm = "AP";
+        const amPm = "Ap";
         const uses24hFormatByDefault = timeFormatString.toLowerCase().indexOf("ap") === -1;
 
         // because QLocale is incredibly stupid and does not convert 12h/24h clock format
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Greek locale, 12-hour clock: AM shown as Π.Μ.
Same setup with the fix: π.μ.

review.text: Switching timeFormatCorrection() from "AP" to "Ap" correctly preserves the locale's native AM/PM casing (e.g. Greek π.μ./μ.μ.), but setupLabels() still measures sizehelper.text with Qt.formatTime(date, format) (C locale "AM"/"PM") instead of Qt.locale().toString(date, format). That underestimates timeLabel.width for locales with longer AM/PM strings and directly causes timeLabel to overflow into dateLabel with no whitespace in one-line mode—the second regression the reporter flagged in comment #7, which was missed because date-beside-time was only checked in English.
changes: In applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml setupLabels() (around lines 603 and 606), use `Qt.locale().toString(date, format)` instead of `Qt.formatTime(date, format)` when computing `timeAm` and `timePm` so `sizehelper` accounts for the actual localized AM/PM string width.
Re-verify in `el_GR.UTF-8` with 12-hour format and date beside time (including a two-digit hour such as 10:xx or 12:xx) to confirm the spacing between date and time is intact.

That underestimates timeLabel.width for locales with longer AM/PM strings and directly causes timeLabel to overflow into dateLabel with no whitespace in one-line mode—the second regression the reporter flagged in comment #7, which was missed because date-beside-time was only checked in English.

reviews.text: The AP -> Ap change is correct and minimal, and the Greek before/after shots prove the casing part. But the reporter's other c7 complaint (no space between date and time with 12-hour or region-default format, e.g. '2026-10-2510:58 Π.Μ.') is the same AM/PM localization problem and was only checked in English: the time label's width comes from sizehelper, which is built with Qt.formatTime(date, format) (C locale, 'AM'/'PM'), while the label itself uses Qt.locale().toString() ('Π.Μ.'/'π.μ.'), so the localized text is wider than its slot and the centered label eats the space before the date. That is why it only happens in 12-hour mode and only in non-English locales, and this patch leaves it in place, so the reopened bug would not be fully closed.
changes: In the sizehelper computation (~line 600) build timeAm/timePm with Qt.locale().toString(date, format) instead of Qt.formatTime so the measured width uses the localized AM/PM text
Verify in el_GR with one-line date beside time, 12-hour and region-default, that the space between date and time is kept, and add before/after shots of that
Mention the spacing fix in the commit message
